superseded_historical_specification.reason_for_supersession: Contained typographical narrative discrepancy in initial C15 text (41 DEV / 39 HOLDOUT) and suffered in-place mutation during C16 pre-transfer verification without cryptographic manifest binding.

epistemic_reconciliation_verdict.question: Which exact specification should every future training run use?
epistemic_reconciliation_verdict.authoritative_answer: data/ops02/OPS02_DATASET_FREEZE_SPEC_v1.0.1.json (OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN). This is the sole authoritative specification for all future experiments.
epistemic_reconciliation_verdict.scientific_identity: Zero scientific content change. The physical imagery, ground-truth masks, parent clusters, and partition memberships are identical to those assembled in C14 and trained on in C16.
epistemic_reconciliation_verdict.future_invariance_mandate: Under GOV-RULE-085, no future agent or script may edit OPS02_DATASET_FREEZE_SPEC_v1.0.1.json. Any future changes must follow a formal semver increment (v1.0.2 or v1.1.0) with an accompanying audit.
